subject: Security kickoff & scope clarification — BrightEdge POC next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@brightedgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security kickoff & scope clarification — BrightEdge POC next steps

Hi Lisa — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the formal security intake:

Call recap:
- Primary goal: validate Redwood for a 3-month Proof-of-Concept (POC) to power summarization and search across BrightEdge clinical notes.
- Key decision criteria: latency under 250ms median for single-document retrieval flows, token-level audit logs, and strong data residency controls.
- Economic buyer: Mark Tanaka (CFO) — procurement will need an SOW + PO.

Systems potentially in scope (as discussed):
1) Production inference API (staging & prod) — models served from Redwood Dedicated for POC.
2) Customer S3 data lake buckets (ingest/export of batch jobs).
3) Analytics DB (clickstream and metrics) used for upstream retriever signals.

Security & legal items flagged on the call:
- SOC 2 evidence and audit timeline
- Data retention and log access policies (who can see KV cache / request metadata)
- Encryption: KMS integration and key ownership for POC vs enterprise

Immediate next steps I propose:
- You share the BrightEdge intake questionnaire (if you have a preferred template) — we’ll complete and return within 48 business hours.
- Schedule a 60-minute security kickoff with your security, legal, and procurement stakeholders + our security engineering lead (Monica). I’m proposing Tue Nov 18 10:00–11:00 PT — is that OK?
- Monica will attach our data retention and encryption summary to help answer the questionnaire’s early questions.

I’ll leave the logistics to you but want to confirm we captured systems in scope correctly. If anything missing or mis-scoped, flag it and we’ll adjust before filling the questionnaire.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0198
https://redwood.inference.com

Sean — thanks for the clear recap. That matches my notes. A couple clarifications before we schedule the kickoff:

1) Systems in scope: please also add the staging SFTP endpoint used for nightly batch transfers (we store transformed PHI payloads there overnight).
2) Retention: our security team needs to know the default and maximum log retention for request metadata and KV cache (audit requirement).
3) Procurement timeline: Mark expects legal + procurement review the redlines within two weeks of receiving your standard DSLA/SOW.

I’m attaching our intake spreadsheet (BrightEdge_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — it’s the template our security team prefers. Please have the appropriate owners fill sections A (Service overview), B (Data flows), and F (Encryption & keys).

Attachments: BrightEdge_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Happy to accept Tue Nov 18 10:00 PT for the kickoff; I’ll invite our security lead and procurement manager once we confirm.

Regards,

Sean / team — I’ll take lead on the questionnaire sections and own the kickoff. Quick answers to Lisa’s retention question while we prepare full responses for the spreadsheet:

- Default request-level log retention: 30 days. This includes request metadata and limited audit logs.
- KV cache: not persisted beyond session for default POC settings; we can enable persistent caching for performance but it’s optional.
- Enterprise retention: we offer configurable retention up to 7 years with an enterprise plan + KMS-managed keys (customer-managed KMS is available).

I’ve attached a short summary that covers data-in-flight, data-at-rest, and KMS options: redwood-data-retention-summary.pdf (application/pdf).

I’ll fill the questionnaire and share a draft by end of day Mon Nov 17. I also confirmed availability for Tue Nov 18 10:00–11:00 PT — I’ll send a calendar invite once Lisa confirms attendees from their side.

Best,
Monica Patel
